claims.label: TPUSA UVU Chapter Declined On-Site Ambulance
claims.claim: TPUSA's UVU chapter declined an on-site ambulance by marking "No" on the EMS section of the school's online event form.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU event form records directly; cross-check against TPUSA's later framing in the wrongful-death filing.

claims.label: UVU Attendance Estimate Progression 200 → 600 → 1,500 → ~3,000
claims.claim: Per ABC News reporting, the UVU event attendance was initially estimated at 200, revised to 600, then per TPUSA to 1,500 (in undocumented later conversation), with actual attendance ~3,000.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU planning documents directly; verify timing of each revision; identify whether any "1,500" update exists in any retained form.

claims.label: TPUSA Framed UVU Event As Open-To-Public / Unticketed Prove Me Wrong Format
claims.claim: Per TPUSA's official statement to ABC News, the UVU event was styled as open-to-public and unticketed, comparable to prior "Prove Me Wrong" campus events, with no crowd control.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether the same open-event rationale was applied to security/staffing decisions; compare to documented Prove Me Wrong events.

claims.label: 2019 Text Thread Forwarded "Operation Greyer X anonymous" Plan
claims.claim: A November 12–13, 2019 text thread shows Andrew Kolvet forwarding to Candace Owens a message attributed to "E" describing a plan to seed a public feud between Charlie Kirk and Candace Owens ("Operation Greyer X anonymous").
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate the text screenshot metadata; verify whether "E" was in fact Erika Frantzve at that time; cross-check against Kolvet's recent public statements on the same feud narrative.

claims.label: 4plebs Post Mirrors The Forwarded "Operation" Plan
claims.claim: The 4plebs post allegedly found by "E" and cited via the Vox article referenced the same Charlie/Candace feud-seeding narrative – ask "gripers" to put Charlie against Candace; "fluff" Candace's ego; frame Candace as driven out of TPUSA by Kirk fearing her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the 4plebs post URL and archived timestamp; verify content alignment; verify whether the Vox article actually linked to this post or only to the broader 4plebs forum.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk's Club America Vision Was Opt-In / Grassroots / Debate-Club Parallel
claims.claim: In his Aspen donors presentation, Charlie Kirk described the Club America vision as a grassroots, opt-in, student-led chapter model parallel to DECA and debate clubs, with 80 new full-time staff dedicated to sourcing leads and guiding student-initiated chapter formation.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full audio/presentation recording; verify against any written strategic plans; cross-check against current TPUSA Club America implementation.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Spoke At Nampa Christian School Assembly; Students Were Not Opt-In Participants
claims.claim: Erika Kirk spoke at a Nampa Christian School assembly where students were not voluntary opt-in participants, per parent emails and student-to-parent text messages describing students unable to leave and "locked in the gym."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the school newsletter referenced by parents; verify assembly mandatory-attendance status; verify whether parental attendance was actually prohibited.

claims.label: TPUSA Claimed 500+ Voluntary Nampa Christian School Attendees
claims.claim: TPUSA's X post claimed 500+ "outstanding high school student attendees" attended the Nampa Christian School event voluntarily as part of the Club America tour.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check TPUSA claim against school attendance records and parent reports.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Cited Three Opt-Outs As Evidence Of Voluntary Participation
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet replied on X that three students opted out of the Nampa assembly and that "over 500 chose to attend" – i.e., nothing was forced.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether the cited "opt-out" mechanism applies to mandatory school assemblies; obtain school policy on opt-outs from assemblies.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Cited Security Reasons For Not Marketing Event Publicly
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet replied on X that TPUSA does not market the events publicly for "security reasons" and thanked Candace for "all your help on that."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check against TPUSA's prior statements on event security; verify whether a no-marketing policy applied to Nampa specifically or to all Club America high school stops.

claims.label: Politico Published Profile Of Blake Neff
claims.claim: Politico published a profile of Blake Neff titled "Blake Neff helped make stars of Charlie Kirk and Tucker Carlson. He's now trying to rein in what he unleashed" (author Ian Ward).
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full Politico article and publication date.

claims.label: Politico Profile Framed Blake Neff's Free Speech Position As "Maximalist"
claims.claim: The Politico profile (author Ian Ward) framed Blake Neff's position as a "maximalist position on free speech" – host notes this is the author's framing, not Neff's verbatim.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify direct attribution of the "maximalist" phrase to Ward vs Neff.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson Criticized Blake Neff's "Make Our Peace With Censorship" Framing
claims.claim: Tucker Carlson publicly criticized Blake Neff's framing that "we may have to make our peace with censorship," reading and rejecting the Politico profile's premise.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original Tucker Carlson platform/episode where this criticism aired; verify whether Carlson explicitly named Neff.

claims.label: Blake Neff Verbatim Censorship Quote
claims.claim: Blake Neff stated verbatim per Politico: "Either we have to make our peace with censorship and explain how we're going to do that or we have to explain how we're going to combat this without censorship. Period. But we've got to confront it."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm full quote and attribution context in Politico article.

claims.label: Empress Films Founded By Emma Cooper In 2020
claims.claim: Empress Films is a documentary company founded by Emma Cooper in 2020; Cooper was previously global president of non-scripted television at Pulse Films and worked on the Netflix documentary "The Disappearance of Madeleine McCann."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify corporate filings and Pulse Films tenure via public records.

claims.label: Empress Films Production Focus Includes True Crime / Murder Mystery Content
claims.claim: Empress Films' production catalog includes true crime / murder mystery documentaries: Ghislaine Maxwell (2021), Marilyn Monroe, Jill Dando, Princess Diana, Depp vs Heard, and Gilgo Beach murders.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify each production's distribution platform, release date, and reception.

claims.label: August 28, 2025 Call Between Erika Kirk / Andrew Kolvet / Empress Films Executives
claims.claim: On August 28, 2025, Erika Kirk and Andrew Kolvet participated in a call with Empress Films executives, including executive producer Eben Davidson (LA office; ex-Paramount) and founder Emma Cooper, plus two unnamed producers.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and obtain direct confirmation from call participants or schedules; cross-check Empress Films project pipeline for Aug–Sep 2025.

claims.label: Candace Concurs With @spilling the TPUSA/UVU Anniversary Observation
claims.claim: Candace concurs with the @spilling the tea observation that holding a Charlie Kirk one-year anniversary event at UVU is inconsistent with TPUSA's UVU-negligence claims.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether TPUSA scheduled an anniversary event at UVU; identify the venue.

claims.label: Candace Concurs With @Koko Rose Tyler Robinson Footage Observation
claims.claim: Candace concurs with the @Koko Rose observation that footage of Tyler Robinson's precinct turn-in was deleted under a "retention policy" while prior footage of him (years-old minor accident) was readily available; host adds that the same two Scripts News reporters also released the Brian Cole Jr. pipe-bomb footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Utah news reporting on precinct footage handling; verify the Brian Cole Jr. footage attribution.

claims.claim: The host states that the show / audience operates as the Decentralized Intelligence Agency (or close variant), a crowd-sourced tip network opposing centralized intel.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve as brand / network framing claim; cross-link M-12 meme occurrence when present.
